responsibility: Provides the shared low-level implementation of gcov file I/O used by the compiler, gcov, gcov-tool, and libgcov via inclusion after gcov-io.h. It owns file open/close/rewrite state, endianness handling, locking modes, position tracking, reading and writing of gcov words/counters/strings/summaries/tags/lengths, record synchronization, and helper utilities such as path mangling and filename emission. This is the core serializer/deserializer for the gcno/gcda/gcfn binary formats.
same_name_distinction: This is the shared low-level implementation of the gcov binary format operations: opening/closing files, endian handling, reading/writing words, counters, strings, summaries, tags, lengths, seeking, syncing, and path mangling. Unlike gcc/gcov-io.h, it provides the executable serializer/deserializer logic rather than the format constants and function declarations.
